name: narrow_range_7_breakout
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, when a 5-second bar's range (high-low) is smaller than every prior bar over the last ~1.7 minutes (20 bars), market-maker quotes have compressed to their tightest spread and resting orders cluster tightly at both sides. A subsequent close above that NR bar's high simultaneously triggers buy-stop activation and TWAP/momentum algo entries, releasing the compressed energy into a 10-20 spot point directional burst within 15-45 seconds. Volume expansion on the breakout bar confirms institutional participation rather than a low-liquidity false pierce.

indicators.name: bar_range
indicators.purpose: Per-bar range at 5-second resolution. The building block for intraday NR detection — directly analogous to daily high-low range in the original.

indicators.name: rolling_min_range
indicators.purpose: Rolling minimum of bar_range over previous 20 bars (~1.7 minutes). 20 bars chosen because intraday micro-squeezes on NIFTY typically form over 1-3 minutes before resolution; the original used 7 daily ranges (7 meaningful comparison periods), so at 5s we use ~3 bars per 'period' × 7 = 21 bars, rounded to 20. This is NOT 12x scaling — it preserves the 'N comparison periods' concept at intraday timescale.

indicators.name: vol_ma
indicators.purpose: 1-minute rolling volume average (12 × 5s bars). Confirms breakout volume relative to immediate recent activity. Compressed from the original's SMA(50 on 1-min bars = 50-min window) to 1 minute because our hold time is 15-60 seconds, not 1-3 hours — the relevant volume comparison window scales with hold time.

conditions: bar_range[i-j] == min(bar_range over last nr_lookback bars) for some j in [1, freshness_bars] (NR bar detected)
close[i] > high[NR bar] (breakout above NR bar high)
volume[i] > vol_ma[i] * vol_threshold (volume expansion confirms breakout)
bar i is NOT itself an NR bar
buy_ce.confirmation: Volume expansion > vol_threshold × 1-min avg, confirming genuine order flow not low-liquidity false pierce

conditions: bar_range[i-j] == min(bar_range over last nr_lookback bars) for some j in [1, freshness_bars] (NR bar detected)
close[i] < low[NR bar] (breakdown below NR bar low)
volume[i] > vol_ma[i] * vol_threshold (volume expansion confirms breakdown)
bar i is NOT itself an NR bar
buy_pe.confirmation: Volume expansion > vol_threshold × 1-min avg, confirming genuine sell-side pressure

exit.stop_rationale: 3 option pts (~6 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5). An NR breakout retreating 6 spot pts within 30 seconds has failed — genuine momentum does not reverse that quickly. NIFTY 5s NR breakouts extend 10-20 spot pts on valid signals, so 6 pts is a clear invalidation level.
exit.target_rationale: 5 option pts (~10 NIFTY spot pts). NIFTY 15-30 second NR breakouts typically extend 10-20 spot pts; targeting 10 pts captures the conservative first leg before institutional momentum algos finish filling. Risk:reward = 1:1.67.

filters.vix_filter: none — NR breakouts are structural micro-squeeze events, not VIX-regime dependent
filters.time_filter: 09:20-15:25 IST; first 5 minutes excluded to avoid pre-open noise
filters.trend_filter: none — strategy is bidirectional by design (NR breakouts go either way)
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at candle close

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — HFT algorithms increasingly anticipate micro-squeeze releases, compressing the post-breakout window

adaptation_notes: Original: nifty100 stock universe, pre-market NR7 scanner (daily range narrowest of 7 days), trade breakout above/below PDH/PDL on 1-min bars, hold 60-180 minutes. CHANGES: (1) Universe: stock universe → NIFTY index; NR7 scanner replaced by real-time intraday NR detection on the index itself — no pre-market data dependency. (2) NR window: 7 daily ranges → 20 five-second bars (~1.7 min); preserves 'N comparison periods' concept at intraday scale rather than blind 12x (12x would give 84 bars = 7 min, too long for 15-60s hold). (3) Breakout levels: PDH/PDL → most recent NR bar's high/low (tightest intraday compression level). (4) Volume: SMA(50 on 1-min) → SMA(12 on 5s) = 1-minute avg; ratio matches hold-time compression (50 min → 1 min). (5) Hold time: 60-180 min → 15-60s (12 bar time stop). (6) Trailing stop and PDH/PDL-based targets dropped; replaced with fixed option premium points calibrated to NIFTY 5s move sizes.
weaknesses: 5-second NR bars occur frequently in low-volume periods (post-lunch 13:00-14:00), generating false breakouts without follow-through
NIFTY's deep liquidity means MM delta-hedging quickly fades micro-breakouts, compressing the momentum window to under 20 seconds on many signals
Volume signal on 5-second bars is noisier than on 1-minute bars; relative volume threshold may not reliably distinguish genuine from noise breakouts in all market conditions
